findings.observation: The inserted pair "When Priya opens the instance integrations page / Then nothing Priya reads there says Replaced." sits after "And the stored secrets key and the Activity are as they were". That Then's support then_nothing_replaced calls instance_activity -> instance_page -> eip::get(world, "Priya", /admin/instance/integrations), a real GET of the integrations page on Priya's own session. The shipped notice is one-shot: SavedNotice::taken_from does session.remove (crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/handlers/instance.rs:432), taken by the page handler on render (:846). An implementation whose replace-page GET stows the I-24 notice in the session therefore has that notice removed and rendered by the harness's internal GET, and the explicit GET that follows reads a page with no notice and passes. The named defect still passes the whole oracle, so E3's fourth clause remains unobserved. The correction does falsify a notice that is never consumed (a sticky one), so it is a partial gain, not a no-op.
findings.remediation: Move the inserted pair above "And the stored secrets key and the Activity are as they were" in both scenarios, so the asserted render is the first integrations-page render after the replace-page GET; the remembered key and Activity are captured by the When before the GET, so the later comparison is unaffected. Alternatively, have then_nothing_replaced read the Activity without rendering the integrations page in Priya's session (read it through the test seam, or assert the absence of "Replaced." on the page it already fetched). One step reorder per scenario, no new step and no other scenario changes. Non-blocking: keep it open as a completion obligation of this slice and correct it before the slice closes.
